summary: Implemented the Grafana-inspired all-machine Host Monitor: metrics-only host worker, coalesced per-host sampling, append-only per-machine 30-day history, fleet/history/sidebar RPCs, searchable in-page cards and drill-down charts, neutral connected/total sidebar accessory, passive thresholds, updated docs/package, and notification/IP/process-control exclusions. All 23 focused tests, type, SDK, and build checks pass; live BB shows 4/4 machines with fresh samples and history.

state.request: Rework Host Monitor into a Grafana-style in-page fleet dashboard. Restore the Host Monitor sidebar accessory icon as a compact quick-access/status control, but keep the full monitoring interface inside the Host Monitor page rather than a popup or floating overlay. Monitor and display every enrolled BB machine, with per-machine CPU, RAM, disk, load, uptime, network and historical panels where available. Preserve notification-free behavior: no toast, desktop/browser notification, alert banner, or warning badge.
